paper_title: Measurement of light-by-light scattering and search for axion-like particles with 2.2 nb$^{-1}$ of Pb+Pb data with the ATLAS detector
notes: Limits on ALP-photon coupling 1/Lambda_a from light-by-light scattering in Pb+Pb UPC. Paper states 1/Lambda_a ranges from 0.3 TeV^-1 (m_a=6 GeV) to 0.06 TeV^-1 (m_a=100 GeV) at 95% CL, assuming 100% ALP->gamma gamma BR. Values read from text (Fig 9); intermediate mass points approximate. This is a collider/UPC bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density. Note factor differences may apply between 1/Lambda_a and g_agamma depending on convention (often g_agamma = 1/Lambda or 1/(4 Lambda)); here reported as-is per paper's 1/Lambda_a definition. | selector: text (sole candidate)
